summary: Kept. Forest Service campground run by VISTA Recreation: $31-45 singles (electric $44, doubles $46-60), 151 sites (141 RV), 19 electric to 50A, showers/flush/dump/store; reservations required on rec.gov; season 3rd Fri March - last Sun Oct (03-19..10-31 for 2027); closed for the season now. --AWH lakefront left as is (H021/H022 measured, see flags). Phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH lakefront, not changed): rec.gov tags only H001, H003, H021, H022 'Lakefront' (H001/H003 catalog points are placeholders). H021 (38.071643,-83.470559) 228.1 m and H022 (38.071845,-83.470516) 227.25 m on 3DEP; Cave Run summer pool 730 ft = 222.5 m is reached ~30-35 m east of H022 (222.2 m at 32 m) on a steady ~15% slope, so the pads sit ~4.7-5.6 m above summer pool, under continuous canopy on Esri imagery. That is above the curation doc's 1-2 m kayak band (a view on the numbers), though the slope is gentle. AWH's 'The H Loop has 15-25 sites directly on the lakeshore' is firsthand: reviewer only.

FEES: high 51 -> 45. The stored $51 is rec.gov's 'STANDARD W/WATER AND SEWER' tier, which belongs to H011 alone, typed Pop up/Tent/Trailer (no RV). Highest single RV tier: premium $45 (electric premium $58 exists in the rate table, but no catalog site carries it). Doubles $46/$59/$60 in fees.note, following the singles-only precedent (1583).
HOOKUPS: electric 30 -> 50 (catalog '50/30' on 10 reservable single sites). Water hookups only at F002 (double) and H011 (pop-up only): left unwritten.
BOOKING: FS 'Reservations required' (fcfs never). The catalog marks G001 first-come; one site only.
PHONE: none stored -> 606-768-2722 (VISTA Recreation, on the FS page and recreation.gov). District office 606-784-6428.
WEBSITE: keep the recreation.gov link; add https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/danielboone/recreation/zilpo-campground (FS page, 200).
STATUS: FS 'Closed for the season' (ordinary seasonal closure, not a status).
PIN 38.0710,-83.4863 is inside the campground (E/F loops); FS point 38.0709,-83.4842 ~180 m E. Loops run from A (-83.490) to H (-83.471). No move.
